tweets.text:
On July 21, 2025, Massena Station Border Patrol agents responded to a report from a concerned citizen regarding suspicious activity in a field on the border near Fort Covington, New York. During their search of the area, agents located an individual south of the field and determined he was an Iraqi national who had just entered the United States illegally. The individual was charged and convicted of illegal entry. He is now awaiting removal to his native country of Iraq.

Your reports play a vital role in national security and public safety. Border security is National security, which directly correlates to public safety.

If you observe suspicious border activity in the Swanton Sector, please contact us at 1-800-689-3362. Together, we can help protect our borders.
